name: Organic Chemistry Laboratory I: Identification, Estimation and Purification of Organic Compounds
description:
Introduction of the lab, safety protocols and precautions. Basic purification techniques –filtration & recrystallization and column chromatography. Identification of organic compounds-physical methods, elemental analysis and functional group identification. Separation and analysis of binary mixtures of
organic compounds by liquid-liquid extraction. Measurements of optical rotation and calculate optical purity.
